input.title: The base path is build-time only: ph connect build --base bakes it into asset URLs and the nginx template, so ph connect config rejects --base

input.description: Setting connect.app.basePath alone leaves the router and the deployed assets disagreeing. Rebuild with --base or build once with --dynamic-base; PH_CONNECT_CONFIG_JSON strips basePath likewise.

metadata.reason: Extracted from apps/connect/RUNTIME-CONFIG.md at v6.2.2-dev.74 — '--base is build-time only'; caveats on connect.pwa and connect.app.offline
Extracted from apps/academy/docs/academy/03-Build/05-Launch/05-DockerDeployment.md at v6.2.2-dev.74 — PH_CONNECT_CONFIG_JSON: 'connect.app.basePath is ignored'

input.content:
`ph connect build --base /foo` does three things at once: writes `connect.app.basePath`, **bakes the value into the Vite bundle's asset URLs**, and templates the nginx config. `ph connect config --base /foo` would do only the first, leaving the SPA's router and the deployed assets disagreeing — so `ph connect config` rejects `--base` up front with an error pointing at `ph connect build --base`.

The Docker entrypoint applies the same rule from the other side: `connect.app.basePath` is **stripped** from a `PH_CONNECT_CONFIG_JSON` payload, because the base path cannot be changed at runtime. The two ways out are a rebuild with `--base`, or building once with `--dynamic-base` so the base resolves at serve time. The shell layer keeps `PH_CONNECT_BASE_PATH` separate because nginx needs it for URL templating before any JSON is touched.

Two other fields share the build-time nature and are worth knowing next to it: the project's own `connect.pwa` block (merged into the web manifest and the service worker at build; carried in the dist file for transparency but never read by the SPA), and `connect.app.offline`, which is hybrid — at build it decides whether a precaching or a self-destroying worker is emitted, at boot the SPA reads it to register or unregister, so flipping it to `false` at deploy time unregisters the worker but flipping it to `true` cannot conjure a worker the build did not emit.

_Source: apps/connect/RUNTIME-CONFIG.md (Powerhouse v6.2.2-dev.74)._
_Source: apps/academy/docs/academy/03-Build/05-Launch/05-DockerDeployment.md (Powerhouse v6.2.2-dev.74)._
